Elita Devi, a queen of the Mughal Emperor Shah Jahan, was known for her beauty, grace and piety. She was the mother of Prince Dara Shikoh, the eldest son of Shah Jahan. She is remembered for her devotion to the Sufi saint Salim Chishti and her efforts to spread the message of Sufism in the Mughal court.
